industry: Measuring, Medical, Optical and Related Instruments

instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Vascular access and hemostatic devices, interventional access devices, surgical instruments and ligation devices, anesthesia and respiratory devices, cardiac support devices, and UroLift implants.

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: Specified maximum contrast injection pressure and flow rates for Arrow pressure-injectable central catheters.

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Clinical use in vascular access, interventional cardiology, surgery, emergency medicine, anesthesia, respiratory care, cardiac care, and urology.

product_specific_regulatory_status.label: Product-specific regulatory status
product_specific_regulatory_status.value: FDA 510(k) clearance for Arrow central venous catheters, GuideLiner catheters, and Weck Hem-o-lok clips, with De Novo authorization for the original UroLift System.

consumables_service_attachment.label: Consumables / service attachment
consumables_service_attachment.value: Arrow catheter kits, QuikClot dressings, Weck ligating clips, UroLift implants, and Teleflex Academy clinician education.

notes: Acute Care and Interventional Urology remain in the profile while their sale is pending. [Teleflex divestiture update](https://investors.teleflex.com/news/news-details/2026/Teleflex-Reports-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results-and-Full-Year-2026-Outlook/default.aspx)
